title: Nebius reports higher quarterly capex on AI cloud expansion
title_zh: Nebius 报告人工智能云扩张季度资本支出增加
summary: Nebius Group on Wednesday reported higher-than-expected first-quarter capital spending, driven by investments tied to the ‌procurement of graphics processing units and data center ‌hardware for its core AI cloud business.
summary_zh: Nebius Group 周三报告称，第一季度资本支出高于预期，这是由于与其核心人工智能云业务采购图形处理单元和数据中心硬件相关的投资推动的。

title: OpenAI's Sam Altman takes the stand in trial against Elon Musk
title_zh: OpenAI 的萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 在针对埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的审判中出庭作证
summary: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman took the stand on Tuesday to face questioning in the lawsuit filed by Elon Musk's attorneys over whether the AI developer breached the original non-profit mission it was founded on. Both Altman and Musk are both co-founders of OpenAI.
summary_zh: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 周二出庭，接受埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 律师提起的诉讼，质疑该人工智能开发商是否违反了其创立之初的非营利使命。奥特曼和马斯克都是 OpenAI 的联合创始人。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq under pressure as chip stocks see red

summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are mixed ahead of Tuesday's market close as the Nasdaq Composite drops by over 1%, pushed lower by declines in chip stocks.
